g.text: wo backlogs · two sprints · one feedback loop · custodians own both
NTOLOGY CUSTODIANS · ACTORS IN BOTH SPRINTS
PEC SPRINT · CADENCE: AHEAD OF IMPLEMENTATION
all four custodians participate · iterate across pending requests · time-boxed 1-2 days
AO · DO · CO refreshed before next implementation sprint
MPLEMENTATION SPRINT · RUNS 1-2 SPRINTS BEHIND THE SPEC SPRINT
agent-driven · spec sprint inputs make every stage faster · several specs ﬂow in parallel
· pushed back to spec sprint backlog
(Change C in the backlog shows what this looks like)
The spec sprint backlog and the implementation sprint backlog can live in the same platform (Jira, Posthog, or equivalent).
The custodians close the loop by rapidly clearing pushed-back items in the next spec sprint.
